currentParagraphText: “Yes... the swordsman,” Nature’s Attendant said. “A Unique Lifeform is a Unique Lifeform. Powerful by default, as is their birthright. However, that swordsman... I cannot quite find the words to describe him. He is overshadowed by his proximity to the Chosen of the Malefic Viper, but we cannot overlook or forget about him. Doing so would be a grave error.”
